neighbours.label: swapping or reversing order ('switch places', 'switch legs', 'reverse the order', 'shuffle')
fire: Have your partner guess, then you switch places and guess again.
Hold for ten seconds, then switch legs and repeat.
What happens if you reverse the order of the words?
Each pair works for a minute, then they swap roles.
Try to reverse the order of the steps next time.
After each round, the two teams trade places.
Stand on one foot, then switch sides.
quiet: Have your partner guess, then you write it down and guess again.
Hold for ten seconds, then rest and repeat.
What happens if you read the rest of the words?
Each pair works for a minute, then they sit down.
Try to read the list of the steps next time.
After each round, the two teams get some water.
Stand on one foot, then count to ten.

notes: Card: ' the' x4, '       ' x4, ' random' x3, ' switch' x2, ' =' x2. Probe: 'reverse the order' 0.63, 'switch places' 0.57, 'switch legs' 0.26, 'random.shuffle' 0.23; 'then rest' 0.00; 'add up' 0.01. New forms: 'swap', 'trade places'.
